intro: Marrakech is a thousand year old city painted the color of the desert, and its walls hide a maze.
facts: Start at Jemaa el-Fnaa, the great square, quiet in the morning with orange juice stands, and by night a circus of drummers, storytellers, and smoking food stalls.
Get lost on purpose in the souks behind it, kilometers of covered alleys selling lanterns, leather, and spices piled into perfect cones.
Look up at the Koutoubia minaret, 77 meters tall and nearly 900 years old, the model for towers as far away as Seville.
Escape the heat in Jardin Majorelle, the cobalt blue garden that Yves Saint Laurent bought and saved, and the carved cedar ceilings of Bahia Palace.
At sunset climb to a rooftop cafe for mint tea poured from a height, then eat a tagine that has been cooking slowly since morning.
outro: Save this for your Marrakech trip.
